title: IP Networking & F5 Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About the Opportunity**  
Ericsson is looking for an experienced IP Networking & F5 Engineer to design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise networking and application delivery services, ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient network operations.

**What You Will Do**  
Design, configure, implement, and troubleshoot enterprise switching, routing, firewalls, and data center networks.  
Manage IP addressing, subnetting, routing, network segmentation, and IP planning.  
Administer HP ProCurve/Aruba switches, routers, and equivalent enterprise platforms.  
Configure and support enterprise firewalls, security policies, and troubleshooting.  
Implement and maintain F5 BIG-IP solutions, particularly LTM and GTM.  
Monitor network services, resolve incidents, and perform root-cause analysis.  
Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, virtualization, and storage teams.  
Maintain network diagrams, technical documentation, operating procedures, and configuration standards.  
Participate in incident, problem, change management, automation, and continuous improvement activities.

**What You Will Bring**  
6–8 years of relevant IT infrastructure and networking experience.  
Strong hands-on expertise in enterprise switches, routers, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.  
Practical experience with HP ProCurve/Aruba or equivalent platforms.  
Strong knowledge of IP networking, addressing, subnetting, routing, and IP planning.  
Experience in data center network design and implementation.  
Hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP, especially LTM and GTM.  
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.  
Ability to work independently with geographically distributed teams.

**Good to Have:**  
VMware, vCenter, vMotion, and DRS experience.  
SAN and enterprise storage knowledge.

**What You Will Get at Ericsson**  
Meaningful work supporting secure and resilient connectivity.  
Global collaboration and continuous learning opportunities.  
Career growth across technical, architectural, and leadership roles.  
An inclusive, flexible, and supportive work environment.

title: Quality Engineering Arch Senior Analyst
description:
**Skill required:** Tech for Operations - Automated Testing  
**Designation:** QA Engineer  
**Qualifications:**Post Graduate in any discipline
  
**Years of Experience:**5 to 8 years
  
**About Accenture**  
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
**What would you do?** Our Service Supply Chain offering combines proprietary technology with client systems to design, execute, and deliver BPaaS and managed services across the Plan, Deliver, and Recover lifecycle. As a Business SME, you will partner with business development to shape resilient solutions that improve clients supply chains and customer experience. Join us to drive meaningful impact and build what is next. The QA Engineer is a detail-oriented, motivated individual who works with a team will ensure the highest levels of quality assurance for our software applications. The QA Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and running QA processes including automatic testing, test planning and defect tracking. The ideal candidate is a person experienced with creating repeatable and scalable testing solutions along with tracking and reporting on test result  
**What are we looking for?** • Proven experience in software development projects in various lifecycle phases include design, build, implementation, and steady state. • Minimum of 5 years of experience in working as a QA engineer. • Proven experience in writing testing cases, plans and test schedules. • Key Skills- Python, Java, SQL, Postman, REST API automation testing, Playwright, Selenium, Azure Test Plan • Experience with testing functional and non-functional components. • Strong experience with implementing and managing automated testing tools. • Experience with automated reporting and live monitoring of test cases. • Postman (Software) - P2 • REST API Testing - P2 • Playwright - P2
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:** • Lead and support the development of frameworks and operating models for building out test cases, plans and schedules. • Design, build and implement automated testing tools and workflows. • Develop standards and metrics for measuring testing success or failures. • Work closely with engineering teams to incorporate testing into both code and data pipelines. • Create detailed and well-structured test plans and test cases. • Conduct root cause analysis activities and risk analysis. • Estimate, prioritize and plan testing activities. • Drive innovation and streamline the overall testing process. • Lead and support testing of multiple applications and dataset simultaneously • Track quality assurance metrics such as defect densities and open defect counts • Understand business needs and objectives. • Maintain strict data security controls and standards. • Adhere to data management best practices and maintain detailed documentation.

  
Post Graduate in any discipline

title: Deputy Manager - MES Rudrapur
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

1. MES team at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, you will spearhead the ideation and implementation of shop floor automation technologies. This involves conducting thorough studies of machines and processes to identify optimized solutions that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy. You will be responsible for understanding and leveraging data inputs from IoT sensors, actuators, and embedded controls, ensuring seamless data collection and integrity at the source.

2.Your role will include developing scenarios for fault prediction and performance enhancement through edge analytics and data normalization techniques. You will drive manufacturing analytics initiatives by designing and consolidating visualization tools and interfaces to facilitate comprehensive machine and process digitization. This requires standardising data collection methods for manufacturing execution systems (MES), enabling efficient integration of supplier process data, and evaluating appropriate technology standards for digital interfaces across hardware, software, and embedded modules.

3.In addition, you will manage multiple projects concurrently from planning to deployment and sustenance phases, utilising tools such as MS Project for effective scheduling and resource allocation. This entails close coordination with project execution teams, vendors, plant heads, IT infrastructure teams, and digital champions to ensure successful MES and digitisation project rollouts. Budget oversight, milestone tracking, and risk mitigation will be key responsibilities while ensuring the alignment of digital initiatives with overall plant KPIs.

4. Key deliverables include continuous engagement in project reviews with stakeholders, managing assets in collaboration with Asset Management, and fostering collaboration with IT teams to support compute, storage, and network requirements. You will also be accountable for developing dashboards and reports that monitor benefit realization, highlight deviations, and propose improvements to enhance analytics capabilities and business insights effectively.

**Experience**
--------------

We are seeking candidates with 2-5 years of progressive experience in industrial automation and manufacturing digital transformation projects, particularly involving MES and IoT ecosystems. Ideal experience includes hands-on exposure to PLC programming, industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, Profinet, and Profibus, and working with major PLC brands like Siemens, Schneider, Rockwell, and Mitsubishi.

The role requires practical knowledge of sensor technologies, industrial device configuration including RFID and wireless systems, and signal conditioning in both linear and non-linear systems. Experience in data analytics using tools such as Python, Pandas, and Matplotlib to analyze manufacturing data and develop predictive scenarios is highly valuable.

Proven capability in managing automation projects end-to-end—right from technology ideation, data acquisition strategy, through deployment and sustained operations—is sought. Strong documentation skills using software such as MS Visio, Word, and PowerPoint to translate technical insights into clear, actionable materials for diverse stakeholders are essential.

Applicants should demonstrate autonomy in problem solving, debugging manufacturing web and distributed Windows applications, and working collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Prior involvement in digital manufacturing environments and manufacturing analytics projects will be advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

Preferred candidates will have experience in the automotive manufacturing sector or original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), where precision, automation, and data-driven decision-making are pivotal. Exposure to shop floor digital transformation within automotive plants or equivalent high-volume industrial settings will enable a strong understanding of the complexities and expectations within this industry.

Experience within industries that emphasize stringent quality management, real-time system monitoring, and predictive maintenance will also be beneficial. Familiarity with automotive production systems and MES integration tailored to large-scale manufacturing will be a significant asset in delivering maximum impact through this role.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech.) with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university.

**Desirable Attributes:**

* Additional certifications or training in Industrial Automation, IoT, Data Analytics, or related fields would be advantageous.
* Continuing education relating to programming languages, automation frameworks, and digital manufacturing applications is encouraged to keep pace with evolving technology.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

Successful candidates should have robust technical expertise in industrial control systems and MES-IoT environments, complemented by practical capabilities in PLC programming and industrial communication networks such as Modbus TCP/IP, Profinet, and Profibus.

Hands-on experience with devices from major vendors like Siemens, Schneider, Rockwell, and Mitsubishi, as well as familiarity with sensor technologies and industrial measurement techniques, is necessary. Functional understanding of data sampling, signal conditioning, and the analysis of both linear and non-linear systems will form the foundation of your daily responsibilities.

Proficiency with data analytics tools, especially in Python including libraries such as Pandas and Matplotlib, is highly desirable to assist in the extraction of actionable insights from manufacturing data. Comfortable documentation skills using MS Visio, Word, and PowerPoint to produce detailed technical schematics and presentations are expected.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate initiative, excellent problem-solving aptitude, and strong collaborative abilities. The capacity to quickly interpret user requirements and transform these into technical use cases will contribute significantly to project success. Embracing a continuous learning mindset and enthusiasm for emerging technologies aimed at operational efficiency is essential.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, we are deeply committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion within our workplace. We celebrate the rich diversity of our team members and believe that it inspires creativity, drives innovation, and enriches our organisation.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to any legally protected characteristics including but not limited to age, caste, race, religion, colour, ethnic origin, gender identity, nationality, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, educational background, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, citizenship, ancestry, or financial status.

Our recruitment process is designed to be accessible and inclusive, encouraging candidates from varied backgrounds to bring their distinct perspectives and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their best.

Together, we aspire to build a workplace culture that reflects the diverse communities we serve and drives sustainable growth through mutual respect and understanding.

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.  

  

You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.  

  

You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.  

  

Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.
* Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.
* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Excellent active listening skills, confirming understanding and seeking relevant information.
* A positive outlook and resilience under pressure.
* A bachelor’s degree in information technology/computing or equivalent experience.
